title: Jonas Johansson
subtitle: PROGRESS NOT PERFECTION
description: Jonas Johansson (1987–) is an anywhere-based artist, educator, and designer from Glommen, Halland, transforming light ✺ technology through ❋ play, community and (un)human intervention.
intro:
Jonas Johansson (b. 1987) is an artist, educator, and designer from Glommen, Halland, based in Stockholm. He has been coding since the age of ten, and studied in Norrköping, Reims, and Stockholm. From 2014–2022 he facilitated learning journeys at [Hyper Island](https://www.hyperisland.com/), and from 2017–2025 taught visual communication at [Beckmans](https://beckmans.se/), covering projection, animation, interaction design, and physical computing. He has worked at [FIELD](https://field.io/) in London, [Moment Factory](https://momentfactory.com/) in Montreal, and [KRAM/WEISSHAAR](https://kramweisshaar.com/) in Stockholm. Since 2018 he has sculpted rooms at [Icehotel](https://www.icehotel.com/) in Jukkasjärvi. Today he runs the artist residency [Visualia](https://visualia.se/), collaborates with the lighting collective [Svartljus](https://svartljus.se/), and shares a studio in Stockholm with [SMASH](https://www.smash.studio/) and [Rose Hallgren](https://rosehallgren.com/).
